Join us and let us focus together on what’s truly important: making lives better with new ideas and the latest technology around the world. Why you’ll love working for Siemens! Conduct data validation and troubleshooting to resolve data-related issues. Document data processes, procedures, and guidelines for consistency. What will you need to succeed? Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field. At least 1 year of experience in data analysis or a related role. Advanced English proficiency. Experience working with cross-functional teams. Familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems is a plus Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI). Strong knowledge of data analysis techniques, including regression, classification, clustering, and time series analysis. Proficiency in machine learning frameworks. Knowledge of cloud data platforms (Snowflake, AWS, Azure). Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Effective communication skills for presenting findings to non-technical stakeholders. Title: Real Estate Data Analyst

Do you enjoy working with AI-powered tools and transforming information into trusted insights? Join a collaborative, forward-thinking team responsible for building and maintaining one of the industry's most trusted real estate fund datasets. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of data, automation, and innovation. You'll gather and validate information from global fund managers and public sources, leverage cutting-edge AI tools to streamline processes, and help shape the future of our data platform through continuous automation and process improvement. Your work will directly support investment decisions made by leading financial institutions around the world. Analyze trends and data patterns to support quality decisions and communicate insights and recommendations clearly to both internal stakeholders and external clients. Document methodologies, validation rules, quality controls, and operational processes to ensure consistency, transparency, and knowledge sharing across the team. Continuously explore new ways to improve processes by embracing emerging AI capabilities, automation, and best practices in data management. Contribute to innovative process improvements that shape how high-quality financial data is collected, validated, and delivered. Grow your expertise in real estate, financial markets, data analytics, AI, and automation within a highly collaborative and technology-driven environment. Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel What We're Looking For We're looking for curious, analytical professionals who are passionate about data, technology, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines strong critical thinking with exceptional attention to detail and enjoys leveraging AI to solve complex problems. Qualifications & Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets, identify patterns, validate information, and draw well-supported conclusions. Experience or academic background in Data Science, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or another quantitative discipline is an advantage. Exceptional attention to detail and a relentless commitment to delivering accurate, reliable, and high-quality data. Outstanding communication and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to engage directly with fund managers and clients through both written and verbal communication. AI proficiency is essential. This is an AI-enabled role where AI and automation tools are used extensively every day. We're looking for individuals who are comfortable integrating AI into their workflow, eager to experiment with new technologies, and committed to continuously expanding their AI capabilities. Understanding of private markets and private fund structures, with knowledge of how investment funds operate and report information. A structured, process-driven approach with excellent organizational and time management skills, capable of managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of quality. A continuous improvement mindset, with a passion for finding smarter, more efficient ways to collect, validate, and manage data.
